firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 7 words, trade+city+outcome in 2 lines; primary CTA Book a visit and secondary See sample prices above fold; phone in header; proof line with Sample rating; next band peeks ~80px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both CTAs above fold, phone visible.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Finding-note signature in hero (F-00), services (F-01–F-08), prices (01–05), reviews (01–04), contact (F-12), footer (END) — 6 sections. Three layout families. Outfit+JetBrains Mono pair unique. Siblings differ.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Outfit display + JetBrains Mono accent for finding numbers, chips, kickers. Fluid scale, body ≥16px, measure 65ch/58ch lead. Tabular numerals on prices and finding numbers. ≤5 sizes. No orphans.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 11 sections, alternating tones, ≥3 layout families, full-bleed break, asymmetric hero. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: process t-deep and contact t-deep nearly touch with thin accent separator, reads as one dark run (-0.5).

photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Hero flue photo in circle scope clip, consistent CSS grade (sepia+saturate). 1440-scroll-25.jpg: service photos consistent aspect and grade. All on-topic, alt text clean. Scope wipe from concept not visible in static frames.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Voice matches concept. Concrete trade nouns (flue, smoke shelf, baffle, chase cover). Sample labels on all reviews/prices/rating. Primary action consistently Book a visit. No banned phrases. Microcopy at form, phone, ZIP check.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg and 390-full.jpg: h1 3 lines, CTAs above fold, tap targets ≥48px, mobile bar works. render.json: 390px overflow 10px from area__text (-0.5). 390-rm-full.jpg: all content visible.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: all content visible under reduced motion. Focus 3px watch outline. Skip link. Fieldset/legend labels. Heading order h1→h2→h3. Forced colors handled.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg: reveal translateY+opacity, stagger on chips, clip on images. Reduced motion shows everything. Hooks: data-reveal, data-count, data-zip, data-open-now. Camera-scope wipe from concept not visible (-0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Finding-note signature is the wow — visit note as page with numbered findings and status chips. Tools designed in finding language. Scope wipe motion moment not visible in screenshots.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630, theme-color, JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness, print stylesheet, lazy images with dimensions, consistent radius and rule weight, designed footer.

elevate.move: Break the dark-band monotony between process and contact by making the FAQ or tools section a full-bleed t-paper band with the finding-note ruled frame, creating a clear breath and a louder-quieter-loud scroll shape.

Implement the camera-scope wipe as the signature scroll moment — pin the circular clip-path on the flue photo while the sweep finding scrolls, so the signature moves in two places and the wow becomes a connected pair.
